verdicts.reasoning_critique: Many internal links do redirect from non-www to www, but the 12-entry list includes an external link. It also includes two final destinations that still 404 and three that resolve to image files. A blanket rewrite to www URLs does not resolve those destination problems, and directly using every recorded final URL would preserve broken links. The recommendation needs to distinguish harmless host redirects from destinations requiring repair.
verdicts.priority_critique: Medium impact is too high for hostname-redirect cleanup alone. The broken destinations warrant their separate higher-priority finding; ordinary redirect removal is a lower-impact improvement.
